mapper.select: SELECT employee_id, employee_code, employee_name, dept_id, branch_id, level, current_projects, is_contractor, status, password, must_change_password, created_at, updated_at FROM employees WHERE employee_name = #{employeeName}

mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET password = #{password}, must_change_password = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employees ( employee_code, employee_name, dept_id, branch_id, level, current_projects, is_contractor, status, password, must_change_password ) VALUES ( #{employeeCode}, #{employeeName}, #{deptId}, #{branchId}, #{level}, #{currentProjects}, #{isContractor}, #{status}, #{password}, #{mustChangePassword} )
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
